pages.text: A "Device" refers to an AE2 network component that performs some function related to the network itself. They almost always require a channel, with the notable exception of $(l:items_blocks_machines/level_emitter)Level Emitters$(/l).$(br2)Some examples include:$(li)$(l:items_blocks_machines/interface)ME Interface$(/l)$(li)$(l:items_blocks_machines/import_bus)ME Import Bus$(/l)$(li)$(l:items_blocks_machines/storage_bus)ME Storage Bus$(/l)$(li)$(l:items_blocks_machines/pattern_provider)ME Pattern Provider$(/l)$(li)$(l:items_blocks_machines/drive)ME Drive$(/l)
